body:
After task:3e7776e9bc407e9f was completed, the strategy agent is still being sent too much by solace.
The assessment of that task was:

> **Assessment: Looks good**
>
> #### Findings
>
> The change does what the human asked: one new command in three forms (outline, chosen steps, `all`). `strategy show task` stays small and only adds `links.runs`. D-99 is recorded properly, and Spec 15 §6, the header and A19 were updated through it.
>
> - `strategy_run_show` reads the log the same way `GET /tasks/{id}/runs/{rid}` does (`transcript(Path::new(run["log"]))`), so the agent sees the same entries the board shows. It removes `log` from the run it returns.
> - `step_list` rejects `0`, ranges that run backwards, numbers past the end and empty parts. `numbered(n - 1)` can't go out of bounds, because every number has already been checked against `1..=n`.
> - `step_line` cuts by characters, so a multi-byte character is never split. The `…` marker compares the byte lengths of a prefix with its source, which is correct.
> - The new match arms come before the generic `["strategy","show",kind,id]` arm and have different lengths, so they can't hide it. The usage text, `STRATEGY_ROLE`, the tool description in `main.rs`, `reference.txt` and the cut message all name the command the same way.
>
> #### Minor points (not blocking)
>
> - For a run with an empty transcript, every step request fails with the message "within 1..0". It's harmless, but it could say the run has no steps.
> - The outline keeps `usage` entries. The plan suggested dropping them, but D-99 doesn't say to, so this follows the decision.
> - A tool entry with no `status` would show as `title ()`.
> - The outline of a very long run is cut at the reply limit like any other reply. The cut message points to steps by number, but the agent can't see the outline lines past the cut. That's acceptable under D-99.
>
> #### Verification
>
> - `rust-board-tests`: 37 passed, including the new `strategy_show_run_outlines_and_picks_steps` and the updated `strategy_runs_read_the_graph`.
> - `rust-unit`: 202 passed.
> - `rust-acceptance`: 91 tests, 0 failed, including the extended `test_strategy_runs_start_refuse_note_and_end`.
> - I didn't run `rust-lockdown-tests` on its own; its tests are part of `rust-unit`, which passed.
> - The acceptance test only checks the outline's shape, not the content of the steps. The unit test covers the content with a real Codex-format log.

-----

but the result after rebuilding solace and starting it again is:

>
> **You**
>
> split out the work required for task:a9d18cc6be1c2a2a into tasks tied to a feature
>
> **Agent**
>
> I can't read task a9d18cc6be1c2a2a yet, so I haven't proposed any tasks.
>
> `strategy show task a9d18cc6be1c2a2a` returns about 80,000 characters. That's over the output limit, so the result was saved to a file. My tools can't open that file, and I have no way to page through the record.
>
> Here are some options:
>
> - **Paste the part that matters.** Send me the task's body and any notes that define the work to split out, and I'll propose the tasks from that.
> - **Describe the work.** Give me a short summary of the pieces you want.
> - **Point me to a spec.** If a file in `specs/` or an entry in `DECISIONS.md` covers it, give me the path or the D-number. I can read both.
>
> Also, which feature should the new tasks be tied to? I can use an existing one from `strategy list`, or propose a new one first. `strategy list` hit the same size limit, so I can't see the feature ids either. If you know the feature id, send it.
title: Finish swing on strategy show task
